run_encode_tokens: run the encode_offline module to encode whitespace-separated tokens into integer IDs using a dictionary
encode_tokens_with_dictionary: encode whitespace-separated tokens into integer IDs using a dictionary and output as CSV
convert_to_choe_charniak: convert input trees to Choe-Charniak format before encoding tokens into integer IDs
encode_tokens_to_csv: encode whitespace-separated tokens into integer IDs and write output as a CSV file
validate_reserved_words: validate that input tokens do not contain reserved words during encoding
